office_does: A Court of Appeals judge reviews trial-court decisions on appeal; Division III, District 3 elects two judges from Chelan, Douglas, Kittitas, Klickitat and Yakima counties.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Megan K. Murphy, appointed by Gov. Inslee in January 2025 and elected unopposed in 2025 to finish the term, is the only candidate for a six-year term.

candidates.summary: Court of Appeals, Division III judge since January 2025; previously a Yakima County deputy prosecutor and civil litigator. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed by Gov. Jay Inslee in January 2025 to replace Judge Rebecca Pennell [S2]
Yakima County deputy prosecutor from 2001, then civil litigation, latest as a partner at Fox Ballard [S1][S2]
Unopposed in the November 2025 election for the seat [S3]
